Interface RegulatedPair

All Known Implementing Classes:
RcxRegulatedPair
public interface RegulatedPair
Two regulated motors that start, stop and report as one unit, such as the two drive wheels of a vehicle. A rotate(int, int, boolean) is one coordinated movement, not two independent ones, so both sides begin on the same control cycle.

Speeds and rotations are in encoder-shaft degrees per side, as in RegulatedMotor. Board-independent code (such as differential-drive navigation) depends on this interface; the RCX implementation lives with the RCX link.
